Hello Priya,

You were charged twice for order ORD-2201. Two payments of ₹999 each settled successfully on 19 August, payment 123 at 10:15:02 and payment 124 at 10:15:05, three seconds apart, and the order itself was a single annual Pro renewal of ₹999.

I have opened a high priority ticket with those details attached so a colleague can review the duplicate and arrange the refund. You do not need to do anything further, and nobody will ask you to repeat this information.
